dct_description_sm: Alternate title: From Natchez to New Orleans.

Alternate title: From Natchez to New Orleans. Hand colored. Cadastral map showing landowners. LC copy 2 imperfect: Pieces missing primarily along outside margin and discolored. Shows plantations with names of owners. Includes illus. Scale ca. 1:140,000. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copy 3 in Maps of the Mississippi River exhibit, Nov. 1973-Jan. 1974, no. 29. AACR2
